quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech press release: Roche's Vabysmo demonstrates sustained two-year results in (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roche reported two-year data from the Phase IIIb/IV SALWEEN study of Vabysmo (faricimab) in polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy (PCV), an aggressive subtype of neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD) that accounts for up to 60% of nAMD cases in Asian populations, presented at the 19th APVRS Congress. Patients gained 7.3 letters in best-corrected visual acuity and had a 127 µm reduction in central subfield thickness from baseline averaged over weeks 100-108; 74% had no retinal fluid at year two; polypoidal lesions showed complete regression in 62% and inactivation in 86% of eyes. Patients on extended 20-week dosing rose from 51% at the end of year one to 61% by the end of year two. Vabysmo was well tolerated, with a safety profile consistent with its known profile in nAMD.
